Generated Narrative: CodeSystem spirometry-grade

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-grade defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
A Grade A3 or more acceptable manoeuvres, with the two largest values within 0.150 L of each other.
B Grade B2 acceptable manoeuvres, with the two largest values within 0.150 L of each other.
C Grade C2 or more acceptable manoeuvres, with the two largest values within 0.200 L of each other.
D Grade D2 or more acceptable manoeuvres, with the two largest values within 0.250 L of each other.
E Grade E2 or more acceptable manoeuvres with the two largest values more than 0.250 L apart, or only 1 acceptable manoeuvre.
U Grade UNo acceptable manoeuvres, but at least 1 usable manoeuvre.
F Grade FNo acceptable and no usable manoeuvres.

name: SpirometryGradeCS
title: Spirometry Grade Codes (ATS/ERS 2019)
description:
Session-level quality grades for FEV1 and FVC as defined in Table 10 of the ATS/ERS 2019 technical standard
(Graham BL et al., Standardization of Spirometry 2019 Update, Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2019;200(8):e70-e88).
The repeatability thresholds below apply to patients older than 6 years. FEV1 and FVC are graded independently.
